originalOperator.localApplicationDomain: 0<q<qStar, where the listed original source fields are defined.
originalOperator.globalDefinition: Apply (10.4) on the original local domain and extend it identically by zero outside. The entire cutoff support lies in q<qStar/2, so the two definitions agree on an open overlap.
originalOperator.divergenceIdentity: div curl(c*A)=0 and div(c*B_e_theta)=r^-1 partial_theta(c*B)=0, using the same original axisymmetric B and theta-independent cutoff.
originalOperator.zeroBranchProof: Inside the original local domain, c=0 and all spatial cutoff derivatives vanish, so every operator coefficient is zero. Outside that domain the global definition is identically zero; no undefined local field is evaluated or multiplied by zero.
originalOperator.plateauProof: c=1 and grad(c)=0 give the original curl(A)+B_e_theta and the same p_loc, with no omitted commutator.
